label: UI Mock: Chat Thread
description: DEPRECATED -- do not use in new scenes. Duplicates chat-simulator's role (generic scripted chat); real Slack moments use slack-workspace, Quotient conversations use quotient-chat, and other generic chat beats use chat-simulator (all performable surfaces with data.script). Kept only so existing projects keep rendering. A chat-workspace mock (Slack-ish layout, brand-colored sidebar) that BUILDS: typing dots pulse, then each message pops in, in sequence. @mentions and links auto-style in brand color. Use for 'the conversation where work happens' beats -- a teammate or agent asking/announcing something.

messages.label: Array of {from, text, emoji?, time?}: each message is preceded by typing dots. @words and links auto-style.

first_at.label: Seconds before the first typing indicator (default 1.1)
